value.note: vision sources included for layout closure; not hardware-qualified on the hybrid

value.operation: prefill FFN gate/up output columns as unscaled i8 x i8 -> i32 (bqv); GPU applies column scales in the fused merge/SwiGLU, computes the remaining columns and the down projection

confirmations.note: Single draft-0 PP@8k request with the shipped fast-path loader binary after a warm-fast load; no statistical claim. Kept out of performance.sessions so the six-repetition sessions above remain the comparable rows.

derived_cache.detail: loader-derived panels_gu.i8 / colscale_gu.f32 sha256 match the lock; cold, warm-fast and LOOM_DERIVE_VERIFY=1 loads; truncation, flipped-byte, touched/replaced source, removed cache and concurrent first-load gates

hybrid_golden.detail: 192/192 greedy tokens equal to the recorded native S1 continuation (draft 0 vs draft 3 / historical hybrid); not equality with the pure-GPU continuation (first divergence token 38); the reference-side record is no longer on disk

kld_2k_strict.detail: absolute gate passes; c509/c765/envelope/tail checks fail (1691 positions). Measured on the pre-package native S1 recipe (same arithmetic); not re-run on this package

kld_8k_strict.detail: mean KL 9.08e-4, p99 9.09e-3, worst full-vocab |dlogit| 3.49 vs pure-GPU controls 6.89/5.29 (misaligned prefill capacities 509/765); 32 prompts, 1451 positions; absolute, c509, c765, envelope and seven tail-rate checks pass. Reported result only: the reduced JSON is no longer on disk (raw logits survive)

memory.note: pool_ceiling_bytes is the devices.json model-pool ceiling, not a measurement. Host peak RSS includes the loader's transient GGUF hashing during cold derivation. No GPU VRAM/GTT or NPU memory figure was recorded.

baseline.args: same loom-serve binary, stock pure-GPU program, --device=amdgpu --memory_bytes=52000000000
baseline.name: Loom pure-GPU

session.note: Same programs and payload bytes with the panels shipped as in-package safetensors instead of loader-derived raw files; measured between the two raw loads

sessions.note: Draft depth 3 (DFlash) decode-stream timing, one request per size. Same programs and NPU payload bytes as this bundle, with the panels then shipped as in-package safetensors (before loader derivation). Baseline = pure-GPU Loom, same campaign. External compiler CPU load was present; the 2k gap normalises to +0.82% per target verification (tg2k-analysis.json).

roofline.scope: GPU-only roofline copied from the GPU control's info.json (loom-roofline). It counts only the GPU's 59 TFLOP/s and ignores the XDNA bank's compute, so it is not an upper bound for the hybrid's prefill. Decode ceilings are omitted: they depend on per-session acceptance, which the roofline tool was not re-run on.
